entities.name: Philip H. Stoll
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip Henry Stoll was a U.S. representative from South Carolina. He is infamous for sentencing 14-year-old George Stinney to death in 1944 after he was charged with murdering Betty June Binnicker and Mary Emma Thames. His conviction was vacated in 2014.
